reasoning: China's Democracy Index score has been consistently very low (around 1.94-2.26 range in recent years). The question asks if the 2025 score (published early 2026) will be lower than the previous report. Given Xi Jinping's continued consolidation of power, ongoing restrictions on civil liberties, surveillance expansion, and crackdowns on dissent, there's reasonable probability of a slight decrease. However, China is already near the bottom of the index, limiting room for decline. Historical data shows small fluctuations. As of March 2026, the report may already be published or imminent.
